page_title: Seedance 2.0 API Live on fal (April 2026) | Video Generation API

summary.name: Seedance 2.0 API (fal)
summary.one_liner: A hosted API on fal for ByteDance's Seedance 2.0 video generation model, which creates short cinematic videos with native audio from text, image, audio, or video inputs.
use_cases: Previsualization of film and storyboard shots
Generating ecommerce product and brand ad videos
Fashion lookbook and virtual try-on video
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Seedance 2.0 endpoints on fal for text-to-video, image-to-video, and reference-to-video, with standard and fast tiers. Inputs include text prompts, images (JPEG, PNG, WebP), video (MP4, MOV), and audio (WAV, MP3), and output is MP4 with synchronized audio. Stated capabilities include director-style camera moves, multi-shot cuts within one generation, and physics-aware motion in action scenes. Videos run 4 to 15 seconds at 480p or 720p, in aspect ratios from 21:9 to 9:16. Access is through the fal JavaScript or Python SDK or a REST API, with a playground for trying it without setup.
notable: Native audio generated in the same pass as the video, including dialogue lip-sync and sound effects
Accepts up to 9 images, 3 videos, and 3 audio clips as references
Separate US-hosted infrastructure option at 480p and 720p with its own pricing and approval process
Fast-tier endpoints trade some quality for lower latency and cost
caveats: US hosting has different pricing and requires a request and approval; faces and extra IP permissions need separate approval
1080p is not yet supported; it is planned
Output is limited to 480p and 720p and 4 to 15 seconds per generation
Pricing for standard endpoints is not stated on the page
